keyFindings.statement: Residual baseline: v3.0 active 111/170 pass (59 fail); v3.6 active 686/1007 pass (321 fail); 0 unreadable
Data files are the post two-tool pipeline residual set (111 and 686 reproduce spec.md section 2 exactly)
Archived packets fail wholesale (186/186, 911/911), dominated by GENERATED_METADATA_INTEGRITY, GENERATED_METADATA_DRIFT, METADATA_DISK_PATH_CONSISTENCY
section 10 rule list is incomplete: 20 rule ids in data, 4 unnamed (GENERATED_METADATA_DRIFT largest)
classify.cjs MECH projection reaches 73%/85% only; 46+154 active packets still-authored under that hypothesis, REQ-002 unreachable without wider transforms or validator policy
Held-back classes concentrate in STATUS_CROSS_DOC_CONSISTENCY, LEVEL_MATCH, FILE_EXISTS, GREP_CONVENTION with derivable detail patterns
Corpus splits match spec.md: data is the full population

20 residual rule classes normalize to bounded pattern families; METADATA_DISK_PATH_CONSISTENCY's 1235 archived patterns are one family; GENERATED_METADATA_INTEGRITY has 6 sub-kinds, GENERATED_METADATA_DRIFT 2
STATUS_CROSS_DOC_CONSISTENCY detail lines are token-plus-bucket pairs (274 lines, 94 pairs, 97 case-only diffs); superseded on the transform question by F-018

Widened projection (active): M-only 138/170 and 927/1007; +templated 143/170 and 962/1007; +policy layer 170/170 and 1007/1007. Derived twice; M tier and endpoint agree, mid tier is classification-sensitive

Policy surface bounded to four families: FOLDER_NAMING (56, includes validator test fixtures), SPEC_DOC_INTEGRITY unresolvable links (~200/295), SPEC_DOC_SUFFICIENCY empty sections and missing citation (~30/170), GREP_CONVENTION warn-level trigger quality
FILE_EXISTS (163) and LEVEL_MATCH required-file (223) report the same absences twice; one stub-provisioning transform clears both
Entry status uses a different axis than detail severity: 10 active rows have error-status GREP_CONVENTION entries whose visible details all read severity=warn
Truncation (3 details per rule) bounds projections from above; zero rows hide a failing rule entirely
Rule-id provenance: 7 rules absent at both v3.0.0.0 and v3.6.0.0 tags; 3 only at v3.6; 10 at v3.0 (AI_PROTOCOLS unstable). Enforcement-at-tag inferred

Artifact-versus-defect: v4-era rule findings are artifacts of new contracts over old docs; 'no anchors found' is a template-era artifact for v3.0 docs while duplicate/unclosed anchors, cross-doc bucket mismatches, broken links and stale paths are real defects
Entry-status axis resolved: helper status line sets RULE_STATUS, detail severity labels are informational inside an error entry; no warnings policy clears the F-013 rows

Correction to F-009: STATUS_CROSS_DOC compares spec.md vs implementation-summary.md Status buckets; clearing routes are evidence-derived bucket alignment or grandfathering; blanking a Status is rejected (masks future findings)

Least validator change: extend check-ac-closure.sh's creation-date grandfather pattern (pre-cutoff packets advisory on every branch) to the F-011 policy surface; per-rule ENFORCE switches exist but global demotion is rejected
TEMPLATE_SOURCE is a first-70-lines marker check; deterministic transform is one provenance comment per document (emitted form at spec.md:13); details in data are bare filenames
Rule implementations split across TypeScript (3 files, 11 classes) and shell checkers (runtime/cli/rules/, 9 classes) where the enforcement switches and grandfather pattern live

Archive exclusion is four mechanisms: FROZEN_TREES + PACKET_NAME_RE (repair-derived), /z_archive/ exclusion (backfill-frontmatter), ARCHIVE_SEGMENT_RE over z_archive|z_future (backfill-graph-metadata); measured pipeline ran archives excluded at the frontmatter step
Correction to spec.md section 2: z_future is skipped only at the backfill-graph-metadata layer; repair-derived name-matches 37 of 39 z_future packets and freezes none; residual explanation inferred

Include-mode breakage: snapshot-location rewrites, historical sidecar churn, archive-segment pointer writes (correct for moved packets, destructive for snapshots), non-digit folders unreachable; safe mode transforms moved packets additively and routes the rest to the policy layer

Cutoff mechanics: 2026-08-30 default, SPECKIT_AC_CLOSURE_CUTOFF override, Created row keying, boundary-day and unparseable-date grandfathering, info verdicts on every branch; later-edit gap needs a finding-level baseline manifest (recommended) or touch-date coupling
repair-derived taxonomy: DERIVABLE 6 classes, REDERIVABLE the 4 graph-metadata assertions only; only observed in-document write is the frontmatter packet-pointer line
Validator tests bind to runtime/cli/../test-fixtures, not the live corpus; corpus fixture-shaped folders break no tests when upgraded
Hard ordering edge is fingerprint invalidation: every doc edit invalidates its stored fingerprint; repair-derived encodes edits-first, re-derive-last including after partial failure
Canonical order: stub adds, composed per-doc rewrite plus pairwise status alignment, backfill-frontmatter, repair-derived (ends in re-derive), validate --strict gate, second-run idempotence check
Doc transforms must be composed per document: TEMPLATE_SOURCE window shift, two-rule anchor parsing, pairwise status alignment make sequential steps self-triggering
Idempotence proof: step fixed point, SC-002 path+sha256 manifest diff, validate JSON identity, apply/dry-run parity, no-new-rule-class assertion per step
repair-derived beyond-reach bucket is the policy layer landing site: grandfathered advisory pre-cutoff, error post-cutoff; vocabulary exists
